title: Sakina phir akeli
body:
haye yateema haye sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi turbat pe koi rone waala
sakina phir akeli ho gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khilone leke aa jaate thay bacche
sunate thay usay asghar ke nauhe
behel jaata tha dil bacchon se uska
sakina phir akeli...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jaane kaun hai kya hai iraadein
haram mein has rahe hai kehkahon se
koi abbas se kehde khudaara
sakina phir akeli...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehed mein keh rahi hai bacchi ro kar
ye zaalim aaye hai ab kyun lehed par
mujhe darr lag raha hai mere baba
sakina phir akeli...
<<DIVIDER>>
suna hai raat ko roti hai dhukhiya
ye kar dete hai turbat par andhera
haram mein chod dete hai akela
sakina phir akeli...
<<DIVIDER>>
bicha kar farsh tanha baithi hogi
bahat ashoor par wo royi hogi
mila hoga na jab baba ka pursa
sakina phir akeli...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehed mein kehte honge ro ke asghar
mujhe chod aayein baba shaam jaa kar
behen ke saath mai apni rahunga
sakina phir akeli...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaho sajjad shaami aurton se
na bhoole saani e zehra ke waade
dar e zindan pe hai phir se andhera
sakina phir akeli...
author: Mir Sajjad Mir
